scope: Candidate serialized storage verification; E10 helpers remain unconnected
verdict: Candidate survives named-project persistence, including a fresh cold boot and later native reload. It is not self-preserving through stock working-cache rebuilds. Both capture on decode and re-emission on encode are required before connecting E10.
required_integration: Validate/capture each record during native project decode, before stock conversion discards it.
Emit records during both named saves and working-cache reconstruction, from the correctly bound per-project pattern bank.
Establish defaults for old/blank/malformed records and guard project replacement before changing bank ownership.
Keep copy/clear/undo, asynchronous replacement and physical behavior as separate validation scopes.
limits: Initial diagnostic records are PC host fixtures inserted at actual native serialize completion; no machine-code persistence hook is claimed.
Cold boot and named reload use the saved private card with no record injection. The emulator storage/DMA/cache models remain in use.
Passing these storage checks does not certify every writer, automatic pattern ownership or hardware readiness.
